# gitea_repository_subscribers (Data Source)

Lists repository subscribers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_subscribers" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `subscribers` (List of Object) Repository subscribers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscribers))

<a id="nestedatt--subscribers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscribers`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `username` (String)
